proof.title: A fake screenshot cannot pass.
proof.lede: Chatfront reads the screenshot, then looks for the credit SMS on the shop's own phone. An order is marked paid only when the amount, the transaction ID and the time all agree.
proof.verdict: All three match: the order is marked paid and a signed receipt goes out. If anything differs, the owner gets Approve and Reject buttons with the evidence.

owner.help: I'm your shop's assistant. To add a product, send its photo, then its name and price in a voice note or in writing. To change a price or a shop policy, just tell me, for example: "lawn 3-piece is now 2,500". To record an expense, send a bill photo with the word "bill". Tell me udhaar like "Bilal ko 3000 udhaar", or ask "aaj ki sale?". Tell me stock that came in ("blue lawn ke 30 aa gaye") or send the supplier's bill with the word "challan", and send "products" or "orders" to see them.

coach.steady: A steady week: nothing stood out in the numbers.
console.forecast_lede: The next four weeks from your own books: a usual week's money in and out, and rent, salaries and bills on the days you paid them before.
console.forecast_no_cash: Write the cash you have now, in hand and in the bank, to see when money may run short.
console.cash_count: Cash you have now, in hand and in the bank
console.zakat_lede: Arithmetic on your figures: cash, stock at what it cost and money owed to you, less debts due now. When it reaches the nisab you enter, zakat is a fortieth. Schools differ on the details; ask a scholar you trust.
console.zakat_cash: Cash in hand and in the bank
console.zakat_unknown_stock: {units, plural, one {# piece has} other {# pieces have}} no cost in the books; add their value to the stock figure.
console.zakat_none: Zakatable wealth {net} is below the nisab of {nisab}; no zakat is due on it.
console.tax_lede: Every sale, expense and refund for the dates you pick, as an Excel file for whoever files your return. Check it with a tax adviser before filing.
console.err.bad_range: Pick up to 400 days, the start first.
console.passport_lede: Your last twelve months of delivered orders, payments matched to SMS and cash at the door, signed so a microfinance bank can check it. Give the code only to the lender you choose; you can revoke it at any time.
console.passport_agree: I agree to share my shop's sales history with the lender I give this code to.
console.passport_delivered: {count, plural, one {# order delivered} other {# orders delivered}}, {value}
console.pay_lede: A monthly salary, a commission on the orders whose chats each person handled, delivered that month, and the day it is paid. Paid puts it in the books once.
console.pay_bad: A salary, a commission from 0 to 50%, and a day from 1 to 28.
console.coach_lede: Each Monday: what moved in your sales, what is sitting on the shelf, and what to try. Code writes every number; the model only adds advice in words.
console.coach_none: No note yet. The first comes on Monday, or make this week's now.
console.seasons_none: No season in the next two months.
console.season_lift: Last year: {category} sold {units} ({times} times the usual)
console.season_usual: Shops like yours usually sell more: {categories}
console.scams_lede: Check a call recording or a voice note, and report scammers' numbers, accounts and links. Chatfront reviews reports before passing them to NCCIA and CERT. Never report a customer here.
console.guardian_title: Check a call or voice note
console.guardian_lede: Upload the recording. You can also forward a voice note to your shop's WhatsApp number.
console.guardian_not_audio: Send a recording or a voice note.
console.scam_review_lede: Numbers, accounts and links shops reported. Confirmed ones go in the STIX report for NCCIA and CERT.
console.data_erase_sure: Erase {name}'s data? This cannot be undone.
passport.title: Credit passport: {shop}
passport.valid: The signature checks out: these figures come from {shop}'s records in Chatfront and have not been changed.
passport.revoked: The shop has revoked this passport.
passport.not_found: There is no credit passport with this code.
passport.note: Payments matched to a wallet or bank SMS were checked by code; payments the owner approved and cash at the door are the shop's own word.
trust.check_lede: Paste the number or account that wrote to you. Only {shop}'s own channels above pass; anything else is not {shop}, whatever it says.
trust.check_label: WhatsApp number, Instagram or Facebook account
trust.check_failed: Could not check just now. Try again.
trust.check_no: No, this is not one of {shop}'s channels. Do not send it money or codes.
standard.how: How anyone can check this signature: the verified commerce standard
console.sms_wallet_checked: Read, and checked on a real message
console.sms_wallet_unchecked: Read, but not yet checked on a real message: you approve each payment
console.sms_share: Share the shape of wallet messages Chatfront could not read, with every number and name hidden, so the format can be added
console.sms_share_kept: {count, plural, one {# message kept to add} other {# messages kept to add}}
console.sms_formats_lede: Every wallet and bank parser, and the shape of messages none of them could read, from shops that agreed to share. Digits show as 9 and names as NAME.
suppliers.cheaper: {supplier} charged less last time: {cost} a piece, against {other_cost} from {other}.
console.suppliers_lede: What each supplier charged for the same item, from your restocks, and one message per supplier for what is running low. Nothing is sent until you send it.
console.suppliers_compare_none: Once you buy an item from two suppliers, their prices show here.
console.price_check_lede: Similar items at other shops on Chatfront in your currency: how many shops, and their lowest, middle and highest price. It is not the whole market: searching other sellers on the web needs the Meta Model API, which is not on here.
console.price_check_none: No other shop on Chatfront sells this yet.
stock.camera_limit: This scan reached 20 frames. Restart the camera to continue.
stock.camera_lede: Move the camera slowly along the shelves. Chatfront reads a frame every few seconds and keeps the highest count seen for each item so repeated frames are not added twice. Review or edit the tally before confirming; stock will not change until you confirm. Each camera session is limited to 20 frames; restart to continue.
stock.camera_error: The camera could not be opened. Allow camera access and try again.
stock.camera_unsupported: This browser does not support camera access.
owner.voice_mode_hint: Hold the microphone button, speak your request, then release. I will read my replies aloud.
owner.voice_tts_unavailable: Speech output is not available in this browser.
